company.description: BrowserOS develops an open-source, AI-native web browser designed for automated web interaction and productivity workflows. The browser is built on a modified Chromium engine and embeds AI agents that interpret natural language instructions to handle navigation, clicking, typing, data extraction, and form filling across web applications. It supports both locally running and API-connected large language models, allowing users to bring their preferred providers or use a default integration. BrowserOS includes features such as scheduled tasks, multi-step workflows, and a built-in MCP server that connects the browser to tools like Claude Code, Gemini CLI, and other developer environments. The product offers integrations with services including Gmail, Slack, Notion, calendars, and CRM platforms, enabling cross-app automation from a central interface. BrowserOS emphasizes local data handling, sandboxed agents, and optional cloud sync for session restoration.
